dedupe_keys.name: godeeep based solar and wind profiles for the reeds bus network

description: GODEEEP-based solar and wind profiles for the ReEDS bus network is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Asia Zhang. wind_historical data for capacity factors in the continental US, processed from PNNL's GODEEEP dataset for a FIPS county-based bus network. Contains 22 NetCDF files. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The repository holds 30 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
